respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture shows an automated AWS Cloud Migration Factory workflow triggered via Slack. We map the Migration Team to a UserCompanyDeveloper actor, Slack and CloudEndure to ThirdParty (CloudEndure is not an individual catalog AWS token), and the AMI elements to AMI. The migration factory orchestrator instance (b5), hot replica (b6), and target account instance (b10) are separate EC2 nodes fulfilling distinct roles in the workflow. All 11 visual lines and spoken interactions match cleanly into logical migration workflows (configuration/triggering, discovery, and replication/cutover).
